title: Starter Sea Quiz
description: A quick starter quiz about the ocean and its wonders.
summary: A fun little quiz about fun facts of the sea.

questions.text: How many main oceans are there on Earth?
questions.explanationText: There are 5 main oceans on Earth: the Pacific, Atlantic, Indian, Southern, and Arctic. The Pacific is the largest and deepest, covering over 30% of the Earth's surface, while the Arctic is the smallest and shallowest.

questions.text: Which of these sea creatures is NOT actually a fish?
questions.explanationText: Despite the name, a jellyfish is actually an invertebrate, not a fish. True fish have backbones and gills, whereas jellyfish are gelatinous zooplankton composed of about 95% water and lack a brain, heart, or bones.
